        return bytes([0x06, len(b)]) + b
    def bit_string(data):
        return bytes([0x03, len(data) + 1, 0x00]) + data
    def utf8_string(s):
        enc = s.encode('utf-8')
        return bytes([0x0c, len(enc)]) + enc
    def utctime(s):
        enc = s.encode('ascii')
        return bytes([0x17, len(enc)]) + enc
    def null():
        return b'\x05\x00'
    def seq(contents):
        if isinstance(contents, list):
            contents = b''.join(contents)
        return bytes([0x30]) + der_length(len(contents)) + contents
    def set_tag(contents):
        if isinstance(contents, list):
            contents = b''.join(contents)
        return bytes([0x31]) + der_length(len(contents)) + contents
    def explicit(tag, contents):
        if isinstance(contents, list):
            contents = b''.join(contents)
        t = 0xa0 | tag
        return bytes([t]) + der_length(len(contents)) + contents
    
    # Create a constructed OCTET STRING with many components
    const_octet = bytes([0x24]) + der_length(2000)
    for i in range(1000):
        const_octet += bytes([0x04, 0x01, 0x41])
    
    # Extension: 1.2.3.4 with constructed OCTET STRING value
    ext = seq([
        seq([
            oid(b'\x2a\x86\x48\x86\xf7\x0d\x01\x01\x0b'),
            null()
        ]),
        bit_string(b'\x00\x01\x00')
    ])
    
    tbs = seq([
        explicit(0, [bytes([0x02, 0x01, 0x00])]),
        bytes([0x02, 0x01, 0x01]),
        seq([oid(b'\x2a\x86\x48\x86\xf7\x0d\x01\x01\x0b'), null()]),
        seq([set_tag([seq([oid(b'\x55\x04\x03'), utf8_string('CA')])])]),
        seq([utctime('250101000000Z'), utctime('260101000000Z')]),
        seq([set_tag([seq([oid(b'\x55\x04\x03'), utf8_string('Cert')])])]),
        seq([seq([oid(b'\x2a\x86\x48\x86\xf7\x0d\x01\x01\x01'), null()]),
             bit_string(b'\x00\x01\x00')]),
        explicit(3, [seq([seq([
            oid(b'\x55\x1d\x25'),  # X509v3 Extended Key Usage
            const_octet  # Critical flag + OCTET STRING value
        ])])])
    ])
    
    return seq([
        tbs,
        seq([oid(b'\x2a\x86\x48\x86\xf7\x0d\x01\x01\x0b'), null()]),
        bit_string(b'\x00\x01\x00')
    ])
